service: Request for Certified True Copies of Birth, Marriage, or Death Certificate / Certification of Civil Registry Documents
plainLanguageName: Certified True Copies of Civil Registry Documents
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: Request for certified true copies of birth, marriage, or death certificates, and other certifications issued by the City Civil Registry Office.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Any valid ID (photocopy)
Authorization Letter with valid ID from the document owner, spouse, child, parent, or grandparent (original and photocopy) – required for authorized representatives
Affidavit of Kinship and valid IDs – required for nearest kin other than those listed above

clientSteps.action: Fill out the request form and present your valid ID to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue an Order of Payment; process the requested document.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present the official receipt and receive the certified true copy or certification.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the Certified True Copy or Certification of the civil registry document.

fees.description: Php 40.00 for certified true copies; Php 30.00 for certifications

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Application for Timely Registration of Birth (Hospital, Lying-in Clinic, and City Health Office)
plainLanguageName: Timely Birth Registration – Hospital / Lying-in Clinic / City Health
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Registration Division
whoMayAvail: Hospitals, lying-in clinics, and City Health Office (birthing facilities)
description: Registration of a birth that occurred at a hospital, lying-in clinic, or city health center, submitted within the required period.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Certificate of Live Birth (Form 102) – 4 copies
Medical Certificate; or Affidavit of Traditional Midwife and City Health Officer Certification (if delivered by hilot); or Affidavit of Mother/Father/Guardian (if child is deceased)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Hospital / Lying-in Clinic / City Health Office

detailedRequirements.requirement: Certified True Copy of Marriage Contract of parents / Certificate of Marriage
Affidavit to Use the Surname of the Father (if child is illegitimate and applicable)

clientSteps.action: Submit the Certificate of Live Birth (Form 102) and all required documents to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; process and register the birth.

clientSteps.action: Receive the registered Certificate of Live Birth.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the registered Certificate of Live Birth.

notes: The registered Certificate of Live Birth is available within one (1) day as processing time depends on the total volume of registrations received from all hospitals, lying-in clinics, and hilot-assisted deliveries.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Application for Late Registration of Birth
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Registration Division
description: Registration of a birth that was not recorded within the prescribed period. Various supporting documents are required to prove the birth event.

detailedRequirements.requirement: PSA Negative Result
National Certification from the National Archives – required for births from 1944 and earlier
Affidavit of Two Disinterested Persons

Any two (2) of the following supporting documents: (a) Baptismal Certificate; (b) School Records (nursery, kindergarten, or preparatory); (c) Income Tax Return of parent/s; (d) Insurance Policy; (e) Medical Records; (f) Barangay Certification; (g) Voter's Registration; (h) SSS E1 Form; (i) Philhealth MDR
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Church, school, BIR, insurance company, hospital, barangay, COMELEC, SSS, or Philhealth

detailedRequirements.requirement: Affidavit to Use the Surname of the Father or Affidavit of Acknowledgment/Admission of Paternity – if child is illegitimate and applicable

clientSteps.action: Submit all required documents to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue a claim stub; process the late birth registration.

clientSteps.action: Return on the scheduled release date to receive the registered Certificate of Live Birth.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the registered Certificate of Live Birth.

processingTime: 13 minuto (at window); certificate ready after 10 working days
notes: The late-registered Certificate of Live Birth is available after ten (10) working days because the application must be posted on the City bulletin board to inform the public and ensure thorough verification.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

description: Registration of a death at the City Civil Registry Office within the required period, using the accomplished Death Form (Form 103) from the hospital or medico-legal office.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Accomplished Form 103 (Death Form) – 4 copies

clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the Death Form; issue an Order of Payment; process and register the death.

clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present the official receipt and receive the registered Certificate of Death.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the registered Certificate of Death.

fees.description: Burial Permit: Php 30.00; Transfer Permit: Php 40.00; Cremation/Exhumation: Php 100.00; Rental fees: Php 300.00 / 400.00 / 500.00

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Application for Late Registration of Death

PSA Negative Result
Affidavit for Delayed Registration
Authenticated copy of the Certificate of Burial, Cremation, or Other Means of Corpse Disposal

clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the registered Certificate of Death.

processingTime: 10 minuto (at window); certificate ready after 10 working days
notes: The late-registered Certificate of Death is available after ten (10) working days because the application must be posted on the City bulletin board to inform the public and ensure thorough verification.

description: Registration of a marriage at the City Civil Registry Office within the required period after the solemnization.

service: Application for Late Registration of Marriage
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Registration Division
description: Registration of a marriage that was not recorded within the prescribed period. Requires sworn affidavits from the contracting parties, the solemnizing officer, and two disinterested witnesses.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Marriage Certificate – 4 copies
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Church / Solemnizing Officer / Mayor's Office / Court

detailedRequirements.requirement: Affidavit of the Contracting Parties
Affidavit of the Solemnizing Officer
Affidavit of Two Disinterested Persons
Certificate of No Record of Marriage (CENOMAR)

clientSteps.action: Submit all required documents to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue a claim stub; process the late marriage registration.

clientSteps.action: Return on the scheduled release date to receive the registered Certificate of Marriage.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the registered Certificate of Marriage.

processingTime: 38 minuto (at window); certificate ready after 10 working days
notes: The late-registered Certificate of Marriage is available after ten (10) working days because the application must be posted on the bulletin board to inform the public and ensure thorough verification.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Application for Marriage License
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Registration Division
description: Application for a marriage license from the City Civil Registry Office. The license is available ten (10) working days after filing and is valid for 120 days.

detailedRequirements.requirement: CENOMAR (Certificate of No Marriage Record) or Birth Certificate or Baptismal Certificate
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Philippine Statistics Authority / City Civil Registry Office / Church

detailedRequirements.requirement: Certificate of Legal Capacity to Contract Marriage – required for foreign nationals
Family Planning Seminar Certificate and Pre-Marriage Counseling Certificate
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: City Population Management Office / City Social Services Office

detailedRequirements.requirement: Parental Advice (for ages 22 to 25) or Parental Consent (for ages 18 to 21)
Cedula (Community Tax Certificate)
Valid IDs
Death Certificate of deceased spouse or Judicial Decree of Annulment or Nullity of Marriage – for previously married applicants

clientSteps.action: Submit all required documents to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; provide the Application for Marriage License Form and conduct an interview; issue an Order of Payment; process the application.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fees at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.
clientSteps.fee: Php 150.00 (Php 148.00 application fee + Php 2.00 license form)

clientSteps.action: Present the official receipt and receive the Marriage License.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the Marriage License.

processingTime: 1 oras at 20 minuto (at window); Marriage License ready after 10 working days

fees.description: Php 148.00 application fee + Php 2.00 license form

notes: The Marriage License is available after ten (10) working days because the application must be posted on the bulletin board to inform the public and ensure thorough verification.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Request for Endorsement to PSA
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: Request for the City Civil Registry Office to endorse a civil registry document to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) for annotation, registration, or authentication. Typically required after receiving a PSA negative result.

detailedRequirements.requirement: PSA Negative Result or unannotated civil registry document
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Philippine Statistics Authority / Local Civil Registry

detailedRequirements.requirement: Certified True Copy of the civil registry document

clientSteps.action: Submit the required documents to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue an Order of Payment; prepare the Endorsement Letter and attach the required documents for forwarding to PSA.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.

clientSteps.action: Receive the Endorsement Letter; proceed to the nearest LBC branch to pay for the courier service and send the documents to PSA.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Review the Endorsement Letter and issue a claim stub indicating the date when the client may follow up.

clientSteps.action: Return the LBC receipt to the Civil Registry Office as proof of submission.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and file the LBC receipt as proof that the document was sent to PSA.

fees.description: Endorsement fee (LBC courier fees paid separately)

notes: The LBC receipt must be returned to the Civil Registry Office as proof that the document was sent to PSA. The client should also follow up with the office for updates.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Request for Registration of Court Decrees and Orders
plainLanguageName: Registration of Court Decrees and Orders
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: Registration of court orders and decrees that affect civil registry records, such as adoption orders, annulment decrees, nullity of marriage, and other judicial decisions.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Four (4) Certified True Copies of the Court Decree or Order

clientSteps.action: Submit the certified true copies of the court decree or order to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue an Order of Payment; process and register the court decree.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fees at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present the official receipt and receive the Certificate of Authenticity and Certification.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the Certificate of Authenticity and Certification.

fees.description: Php 300.00 registration fee + Php 100.00 certification fee

service: Legitimation
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: Processing of legitimation for children born to parents who were not legally married at the time of birth but have subsequently married. The birth certificate is annotated to reflect the child's legitimate status.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Birth Certificate of the child (PSA copy or local copy)
Joint Affidavit of Legitimation; or RA 9858 requirements if a parent was a minor at the time of the child's conception
Certified True Copy of Marriage Contract of the parents
CENOMAR (Certificate of No Marriage Record) of both parents
Valid IDs of both parents

clientSteps.action: Submit all required documents to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue an Order of Payment; issue a claim stub; process the legitimation.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present the official receipt and receive the annotated Certificate of Live Birth.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the annotated Certificate of Live Birth.

processingTime: 44 minuto (at window); annotated certificate ready after 3 working days
notes: The annotated Certificate of Live Birth is available after three (3) working days. The document will be thoroughly verified, and if the client requests endorsement to PSA, additional processing time applies.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Request for Correction of Clerical Errors in Civil Registry Documents (RA 9048)
plainLanguageName: Correction of Clerical Errors in Civil Registry Documents (RA 9048)
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: Administrative correction of obvious clerical or typographical errors in civil registry documents (birth, marriage, death certificates) without a court order, under Republic Act 9048. Petition is posted on the City bulletin board and may be published in a local newspaper.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Certified true machine copy of the certificate or registry book entry page (PSA SECPA copy)

At least two (2) public or private documents showing the correct entry: (a) Baptismal Certificate; (b) Birth Certificate of spouse/parent (for marriage); (c) Voter's Affidavit/Registration; (d) GSIS/SSS Record; (e) Medical Record; (f) Business Record; (g) School Records
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Church, PSA, COMELEC, GSIS/SSS, hospital, school

detailedRequirements.requirement: Other relevant documents as required by the Civil Registrar

clientSteps.action: Submit all required documents to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue an Order of Payment.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present the official receipt; sign and complete the petition form; receive the claim stub.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Process and have the client sign the petition form; issue a claim stub. The petition will be posted on the bulletin board for ten (10) days and published in a local newspaper once a week.

processingTime: 2 oras at 32 minuto (at window); petition forwarded to PSA after 18 working days

fees.description: RA 9048 correction of clerical errors fee

notes: The petition is forwarded to PSA after eighteen (18) working days from submission to the office.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

Police Clearance
NBI Clearance
Affidavit of Non-Employment, Certificate of Employment, or Affidavit of Self-Employment
Affidavit of Publication and copy of newspaper clipping (from a newspaper of general circulation)

clientSteps.action: Present the official receipt; sign and complete the petition form; receive the claim stub.

plainLanguageName: Correction of Date of Birth or Sex in Birth Certificate (RA 10172)
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: Administrative petition to correct the day and month of birth or change the sex entry in a birth certificate under Republic Act 10172. Requires medical certification, multiple clearances, and newspaper publication.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Certified true machine copy of the birth certificate (both PSA and LCRO copies)
Police Clearance
NBI Clearance
Affidavit of Non-Employment, Certificate of Employment, or Affidavit of Self-Employment
Earliest school record or school documents
Medical Records
Medical Certificate from a government-accredited physician
Baptismal Certificate
Voter's Affidavit or Voter's Registration Record
Affidavit of Publication and copy of newspaper clipping (from a newspaper of general circulation)
Other relevant documents as required by the Civil Registrar

clientSteps.action: Submit all required documents to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue an Order of Payment.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present the official receipt; sign and complete the petition form; receive the claim stub.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Process and have the client sign the petition form; issue a claim stub. The petition will be posted on the bulletin board for ten (10) days and published in a local newspaper once a week.

processingTime: 2 oras at 32 minuto (at window); petition forwarded to PSA after 18 working days

fees.description: RA 10172 correction fee for date of birth or sex entry

notes: The petition is forwarded to PSA after eighteen (18) working days from submission to the office.

service: Request for Certificate of Finality and Annotation (RA 9048 & RA 10172)
plainLanguageName: Certificate of Finality and Annotation (RA 9048 / RA 10172)
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: Issuance of the Certificate of Finality and corresponding annotation on the civil registry document after an approved RA 9048 or RA 10172 petition. The annotation is from PSA and may take several months.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Valid IDs
Authorization Letter – required for authorized representatives
Request Form

clientSteps.action: Fill out and submit the request form to the civil registry staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the request form; prepare the Certificate of Finality and Annotation.

clientSteps.action: Receive the Certificate of Finality and Annotation.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the Certificate of Finality and Annotation.

notes: The Certificate of Finality is issued within one (1) hour after the finality notice is received from PSA. The waiting period for PSA finality may exceed four (4) months. Clients may call the office to follow up, and they will be notified when the document is ready.

description: Registration of the Affidavit to Use the Surname of the Father (AUSF) for illegitimate children whose father's acknowledgment has not been previously registered in their birth certificate.

Cedula (Community Tax Certificate)
Valid IDs

clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.

officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: Annotation of the birth certificate to reflect the use of the father's surname for an illegitimate child whose father's acknowledgment is already registered. The birth certificate will carry the annotation after 5 working days.

processingTime: 27 minuto (at window); annotated birth certificate ready after 5 working days
notes: The annotated Certificate of Live Birth is available after five (5) working days.

service: Batch Request Entry System (BREQS) – Request for PSA Documents
officeDivision: City Civil Registry Office - Civil Certification and Archival Division
description: The City Civil Registry Office facilitates requests for PSA-issued documents (birth, marriage, death certificates, and CENOMAR) through the Batch Request Entry System (BREQS). Documents are sourced from PSA San Pablo and available within 5 working days.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Accomplished BREQS Request Form
Any valid ID of the document owner, spouse, child, parent, or grandparent
Authorization Letter and valid IDs (photocopy) – required for authorized representatives
Affidavit of Kinship and valid IDs – required for nearest kin

clientSteps.action: Fill out the request form and present your valid ID and other required identification.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; issue an Order of Payment.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fees at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the payment and issue an official receipt.
clientSteps.fee: Php 75.00 (service fee) + Php 155.00 (birth/marriage/death cert) or Php 210.00 (CENOMAR)

clientSteps.action: Present the receipt confirming PSA document payment.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Verify the receipt; review the request form details; encode the request in the BREQS system.

clientSteps.action: Return after 5 working days to receive the PSA document.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the PSA document.

processingTime: 42 minuto (at window); PSA document ready after 5 working days

fees.amount: Php 75.00 service fee + Php 155.00 (birth/marriage/death cert) or Php 210.00 (CENOMAR)
fees.description: Php 75.00 service fee; Php 155.00 for birth, marriage, or death certificate; Php 210.00 for CENOMAR

notes: PSA document is available after five (5) working days as it is retrieved from PSA San Pablo.

service: Free Notarization of Prepared Legal Documents
officeDivision: City Legal Services Office
description: The City Legal Services Office provides free notarization services for qualified residents of Calamba. Clients must present a Certificate of Indigency and personally appear before the notary.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Certificate of Indigency
Three (3) copies of the document to be notarized (e.g., Affidavit of Loss, Contract) – must be fully prepared and ready
Valid IDs
Personal appearance of the person to be notarized (Contracting Parties / Affiant / Declarant)
Notarized Special Power of Attorney or Notarized Authorization Letter – required if the document does not belong to the client

clientSteps.action: Submit all required documents to the City Legal Services Office staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and assess the submitted documents. If complete: proceed with notarization. If incomplete: return documents and inform the client of the deficiency. Review the document for the appropriate notarial action and notarize.
clientSteps.personResponsible: City Legal Services Staff, City Legal Officer

clientSteps.action: Receive the notarized documents and sign the notarial log.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Record in the notarial log; retain 2 copies of the document for the office file.
